fields.label: Name
fields.help: Unique generator identifier. Time-series profiles are matched to this exact name.

fields.label: Carrier
fields.help: Technology carrier (solar, onwind, OCGT, …). Drives CO₂ accounting, grouping and canvas colours.

fields.label: Bus
fields.help: Bus the generator injects into.

fields.label: Capacity
fields.help: Installed active-power capacity. With extendable ticked, the existing capacity the optimiser starts from.

fields.label: Extendable
fields.help: When ticked, the optimiser chooses the capacity between the minimum and maximum and pays the annualised cost for every MW it adds.

fields.label: Minimum capacity
fields.help: Lower bound on the optimised capacity. Set it to the existing capacity to forbid retirement.

fields.label: Maximum capacity
fields.help: Upper bound on the optimised capacity. Leave empty for no limit.

fields.label: Overnight cost
fields.help: Upfront cost per unit of capacity, as if built at once without financing. Annualised over the lifetime at the discount rate.

fields.label: Lifetime
fields.help: Technical and economic lifetime. The asset retires after its build year plus lifetime.

fields.label: Build year
fields.help: First year the asset operates. With its lifetime, it decides in which investment periods the asset exists.

fields.label: Discount rate
fields.help: The rate this asset's overnight cost is annualised at. Leave empty to use the project's rate from Solver Settings.

fields.label: Capital cost (annualised)
fields.help: Derived: overnight cost × annuity(discount rate, lifetime); fixed O&M is charged on top. The optimiser pays it on every MW it adds, for the share of a year your snapshots represent.

fields.label: Fixed O&M
fields.help: Fixed operation and maintenance per installed unit per year, paid on the whole capacity whatever the dispatch.

fields.label: Marginal cost
fields.help: Variable cost per MWh dispatched: fuel plus variable O&M.

fields.label: Curtailment cost
fields.help: Penalty per MWh of available but unused energy. Set above zero to discourage spilling wind or solar.

fields.label: Start-up cost
fields.help: Cost of one start-up.

fields.label: Shut-down cost
fields.help: Cost of one shut-down.

fields.label: Efficiency
fields.help: Conversion efficiency from primary energy to electricity. Used for CO₂ accounting (carrier emissions ÷ efficiency).

fields.label: Minimum output
fields.help: Minimum dispatch as a share of capacity: a must-run floor.

fields.label: Availability
fields.help: Maximum dispatch as a share of capacity. For wind and solar, the time-varying capacity factor uploaded as a profile.

fields.label: Unit commitment
fields.help: Model on/off decisions with start-ups and minimum up and down times. Adds integer variables: slower, more realistic for thermal plants.

fields.label: Ramp-up limit
fields.help: Largest hour-on-hour increase, as a share of capacity per hour.

fields.label: Ramp-down limit
fields.help: Largest hour-on-hour decrease, as a share of capacity per hour.

fields.label: Minimum up time
fields.help: Hours the unit stays on after a start-up.

fields.label: Minimum down time
fields.help: Hours the unit stays off after a shut-down.

fields.label: Minimum energy
fields.help: Least energy the generator must produce over the modelled horizon (Σ dispatch × weight). Empty for no lower bound.

fields.label: Maximum energy
fields.help: Most energy the generator may produce over the modelled horizon, e.g. a fuel or water budget. Empty for no upper bound.

fields.label: AC control
fields.help: Control type in the AC power flow only: PQ fixes P and Q, PV holds the voltage, Slack absorbs the imbalance.

fields.label: Forced-outage rate
fields.help: Share of time the asset is out on a forced outage, e.g. 5 %. Empty uses the carrier's library default. Read by the adequacy and FMEA analysis only; the dispatch is unaffected.

fields.label: Outage-rate basis
fields.help: What the rate is: FOR (service-hours based, what NERC GADS class averages publish) or EFORd (demand based). The tool stores which one you entered and never converts between them.

fields.label: Mean time to repair
fields.help: How long one forced outage lasts on average. With the rate it implies an event frequency (8760 × rate / MTTR per year).

fields.label: Availability includes outages
fields.help: Tick when the availability profile already accounts for forced outages (a historical capacity-factor table). The adequacy engines then apply no outage rate on top.

fields.label: Name
fields.help: Unique link identifier. Time-series profiles are matched to this exact name.

fields.label: Carrier
fields.help: Technology carrier (electrolysis, fuel cell, DC, heat pump, …). Drives grouping and canvas colours.

fields.label: From bus
fields.help: Input side: the bus the link draws from. Its capacity and cost are per MW of this input.

fields.label: To bus
fields.help: Output side: the bus that receives the input × efficiency.

fields.label: Capacity
fields.help: Rating on the input side (bus0). With extendable ticked, the existing capacity the optimiser starts from.

fields.label: Extendable
fields.help: When ticked, the optimiser chooses the capacity between the minimum and maximum and pays the annualised cost for every MW it adds.

fields.label: Minimum capacity
fields.help: Lower bound on the optimised capacity. Set it to the existing capacity to forbid retirement.

fields.label: Maximum capacity
fields.help: Upper bound on the optimised capacity. Leave empty for no limit.

fields.label: Overnight cost
fields.help: Upfront cost per kW of input capacity, as if built at once without financing. Annualised over the lifetime at the discount rate.

fields.label: Lifetime
fields.help: Technical and economic lifetime. The link retires after its build year plus lifetime.

fields.label: Build year
fields.help: First year the asset operates. With its lifetime, it decides in which investment periods the asset exists.

fields.label: Discount rate
fields.help: The rate this asset's overnight cost is annualised at. Leave empty to use the project's rate from Solver Settings.

fields.label: Capital cost (annualised)
fields.help: Derived: overnight cost × annuity(discount rate, lifetime); fixed O&M is charged on top. Per kW of input.

fields.label: Fixed O&M
fields.help: Fixed operation and maintenance per kW of input per year.

fields.label: Marginal cost
fields.help: Cost per MWh drawn from the input bus.

fields.label: Efficiency
fields.help: Output per unit of input: MWh delivered to bus1 per MWh drawn from bus0 (the COP for a heat pump, above 100 %).

fields.label: Minimum flow
fields.help: Lowest flow as a share of capacity. Negative lets the link run backwards (−100 % for a bidirectional DC line).

fields.label: Maximum flow
fields.help: Highest flow as a share of capacity. A profile uploaded on the Time Series page replaces this value hour by hour.

fields.label: Forced-outage rate
fields.help: Share of time the asset is out on a forced outage, e.g. 5 %. Empty uses the carrier's library default. Read by the adequacy and FMEA analysis only; the dispatch is unaffected.

fields.label: Outage-rate basis
fields.help: What the rate is: FOR (service-hours based, what NERC GADS class averages publish) or EFORd (demand based). The tool stores which one you entered and never converts between them.

fields.label: Mean time to repair
fields.help: How long one forced outage lasts on average. With the rate it implies an event frequency (8760 × rate / MTTR per year).

fields.label: Name
fields.help: Unique load identifier. Time-series profiles are matched to this exact name.

fields.label: Carrier
fields.help: Energy carrier of the demand (AC, heat, H2, …). Used for grouping.

fields.label: Bus
fields.help: Bus the demand is drawn from.

fields.label: Demand
fields.help: Active-power demand. A profile uploaded on the Time Series page replaces this static value hour by hour.

fields.label: Reactive demand
fields.help: Reactive-power demand, used by the AC power flow only.

fields.label: Sign
fields.help: Power sign convention: −1 for a consumer (the default), +1 to make the load inject power.

fields.label: Name
fields.help: Unique storage unit identifier. Time-series profiles are matched to this exact name.

fields.label: Carrier
fields.help: Storage technology (battery, PHS, …). Used for grouping; does not change the energy balance.

fields.label: Bus
fields.help: Bus the storage charges from and discharges to.

fields.label: Power
fields.help: Charge and discharge rating on the AC side.

fields.label: Duration
fields.help: Hours of storage at rated power: energy = power × duration.

fields.label: Extendable
fields.help: When ticked, the optimiser chooses the capacity between the minimum and maximum and pays the annualised cost for every MW it adds.

fields.label: Minimum capacity
fields.help: Lower bound on the optimised capacity. Set it to the existing capacity to forbid retirement.

fields.label: Maximum capacity
fields.help: Upper bound on the optimised capacity. Leave empty for no limit.

fields.label: Power part: overnight cost
fields.help: Upfront cost of the power conversion (inverter, grid connection) per kW of power.

fields.label: Power part: lifetime
fields.help: Lifetime of the power part. When shorter than the energy part's, finance books a replacement.

fields.label: Energy part: overnight cost
fields.help: Upfront cost of the storage block per kWh of energy.

fields.label: Energy part: lifetime
fields.help: Lifetime of the storage block.

fields.label: Build year
fields.help: First year the asset operates. With its lifetime, it decides in which investment periods the asset exists.

fields.label: Discount rate
fields.help: The rate this asset's overnight cost is annualised at. Leave empty to use the project's rate from Solver Settings.

fields.label: Lifetime
fields.help: Derived: the longest part lifetime, the one the asset retires with.

fields.label: Capital cost (annualised)
fields.help: Derived from both parts: each part's overnight cost annualised over its own lifetime, the energy part scaled by the duration; fixed O&M is charged on top. Per kW of power.

fields.label: Power part: fixed O&M
fields.help: Fixed O&M of the power part, as a share of its overnight cost per year.

fields.label: Energy part: fixed O&M
fields.help: Fixed O&M of the storage block, as a share of its overnight cost per year.

fields.label: Fixed O&M (total)
fields.help: Derived: both parts' fixed O&M per kW of power per year.

fields.label: Marginal cost
fields.help: Cost per MWh dispatched, e.g. to model wear.

fields.label: Charging efficiency
fields.help: Share of the electricity drawn that reaches the store.

fields.label: Discharging efficiency
fields.help: Share of the stored energy delivered as electricity.

fields.label: Standing loss
fields.help: Share of the state of charge lost each hour (self-discharge).

fields.label: Cyclic state of charge
fields.help: The state of charge at the end must equal the start, so the model cannot start with free energy.

fields.label: Initial state of charge
fields.help: Energy in the store at the first snapshot. Ignored when the state of charge is cyclic.

fields.label: Inflow
fields.help: Energy flowing into the store from outside, e.g. river inflow for hydro. Upload a profile on the Time Series page for hourly values.

fields.label: Forced-outage rate
fields.help: Share of time the asset is out on a forced outage, e.g. 5 %. Empty uses the carrier's library default. Read by the adequacy and FMEA analysis only; the dispatch is unaffected.

fields.label: Outage-rate basis
fields.help: What the rate is: FOR (service-hours based, what NERC GADS class averages publish) or EFORd (demand based). The tool stores which one you entered and never converts between them.

fields.label: Mean time to repair
fields.help: How long one forced outage lasts on average. With the rate it implies an event frequency (8760 × rate / MTTR per year).

fields.label: Name
fields.help: Unique store identifier. Time-series profiles are matched to this exact name.

fields.label: Carrier
fields.help: Energy carrier held (H2, heat, battery, …). Used for grouping; does not change the energy balance.

fields.label: Bus
fields.help: Bus the store exchanges energy with. It has no power limit of its own: the Links and other components on that bus set the charge and discharge rate.

fields.label: Energy capacity
fields.help: Energy the store can hold. With extendable ticked, the existing capacity the optimiser starts from.

fields.label: Extendable
fields.help: When ticked, the optimiser chooses the energy capacity between the minimum and maximum and pays the annualised cost for every MWh it adds.

fields.label: Minimum capacity
fields.help: Lower bound on the optimised energy capacity.

fields.label: Maximum capacity
fields.help: Upper bound on the optimised energy capacity. Leave empty for no limit.

fields.label: Overnight cost
fields.help: Upfront cost per kWh of storage capacity, as if built at once without financing. Annualised over the lifetime at the discount rate.

fields.label: Lifetime
fields.help: Technical and economic lifetime. The store retires after its build year plus lifetime.

fields.label: Build year
fields.help: First year the asset operates. With its lifetime, it decides in which investment periods the asset exists.

fields.label: Discount rate
fields.help: The rate this asset's overnight cost is annualised at. Leave empty to use the project's rate from Solver Settings.

fields.label: Capital cost (annualised)
fields.help: Derived: overnight cost × annuity(discount rate, lifetime); fixed O&M is charged on top. Per kWh of capacity.

fields.label: Fixed O&M
fields.help: Fixed operation and maintenance per kWh of capacity per year.

fields.label: Marginal cost
fields.help: Cost per MWh discharged.

fields.label: Minimum state of energy
fields.help: Lowest allowed fill level, as a share of the energy capacity.

fields.label: Maximum state of energy
fields.help: Highest allowed fill level, as a share of the energy capacity.

fields.label: Cyclic state of energy
fields.help: The fill level at the end must equal the start, so the model cannot start with free energy.

fields.label: Initial energy
fields.help: Energy in the store at the first snapshot. Ignored when the state of energy is cyclic.

fields.label: Standing loss
fields.help: Share of the stored energy lost each hour (self-discharge, boil-off).

fields.label: Forced-outage rate
fields.help: Share of time the asset is out on a forced outage, e.g. 5 %. Empty uses the carrier's library default. Read by the adequacy and FMEA analysis only; the dispatch is unaffected.

fields.label: Outage-rate basis
fields.help: What the rate is: FOR (service-hours based, what NERC GADS class averages publish) or EFORd (demand based). The tool stores which one you entered and never converts between them.

fields.label: Mean time to repair
fields.help: How long one forced outage lasts on average. With the rate it implies an event frequency (8760 × rate / MTTR per year).
